meta.title: Board, Advisors, and Maintainers - Open Healthcare Network Foundation
meta.description: Foundation board, advisory board, governance layers, and maintainers stewarding OHC Foundation and CARE.

hero.title: A full institution around CARE Core.
hero.body: OHC Foundation is being built as a durable home for open healthcare infrastructure: board stewardship, independent advisors, foundation operators, and maintainers close to the code and field deployments.

layers.title: Board, advisors, team, and maintainers have different jobs.
layers.body: This separation matters. The board safeguards the institution. Advisors sharpen direction. The foundation team operates the roadmap. Maintainers protect technical quality.

board.title: Foundation Board
board.text: Mission, fiduciary oversight, risk, funding, legal accountability, and long-term institutional stewardship.

advisors.title: Advisory Board
advisors.text: Independent guidance from public infrastructure, health systems, philanthropy, technology, and open-source leaders.

team.title: Foundation Team
team.text: Product, engineering, AI, community, partnerships, and operating leadership for OHC Foundation.

maintainers.title: Maintainers
maintainers.text: Architecture, code review, release discipline, security, documentation, and contributor pathways.

board.title: Board stewardship for a neutral healthcare commons.
board.description: The foundation board provides institutional oversight for mission, fiduciary responsibility, partnerships, and long-term trust.

advisors.title: Independent guidance for public-good infrastructure.
advisors.description: The advisory board section is designed to grow as OHC adds leaders from digital public infrastructure, healthcare, philanthropy, standards, and open source.

athulJosephManuel.role: President, IMA Kochi / Chief Medical Officer

maintainers.title: The wider technical community remains central.
maintainers.body: The public roster will grow as maintainer, clinical, and project committee roles are confirmed. For now, this page reserves the structure for a complete foundation team page.

final.title: Open healthcare infrastructure needs visible stewardship.
final.body: The roster will expand as the foundation formalizes additional board, advisory, maintainer, clinical, and operating roles.
